title: leucanthemum eliasii
intro: Leucanthemum eliasii, commonly known as Elias' white daisy or daisy fleabane, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum eliasii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with conditions such as arthritis and digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
